name: Keep profiles
description:
1. Request: make the profiles selected in the chat input box persist like the LLM model selection does.
2. Investigation: model selection was persisted on `chat.llm_model`, while composer profiles lived only in transient component state (`selectorProfileNames`).
3. Fix: `Chat.vue` now restores `selectorProfileNames` from `chat.profiles` in `initProject()` and persists it via a new `saveSelectedProfiles()` method.
4. Wiring: `onProfilesSelected()`, `onResetEdit()` and `onProfilesChanged()` were updated so both profile selectors stay in sync with the chat record.
5. File change applied to `.worktrees/mobile_redesign/client/src/components/chat/Chat.vue`; no API, store or child-component changes were needed.
